issues.description: The PersonResource constructor in the solution repository has an incorrect parameter type: it declares a String parameter but assigns it to the PersonService field. In the template repository the constructor correctly expects a PersonService. This mismatch in the solution is a structural bug (constructor signature/type mismatch) that will prevent the application from compiling and will confuse students who compare the template and the provided solution. It also breaks Spring's ability to inject the service into the controller (since the parameter type is wrong).
issues.suggested_fix: In the solution repository, change the PersonResource constructor to accept a PersonService and assign it to the field. For example: public PersonResource(PersonService personService) { this.personService = personService; } This matches the template, allows Spring to inject the service, and restores a compilable, consistent implementation.

issues.description: The problem statement and template describe a PersonResource that depends on PersonService (web layer -> application layer). In the template, the PersonResource constructor correctly accepts a PersonService parameter (PersonResource(PersonService personService)). In the solution repository, the PersonResource constructor signature incorrectly accepts a String parameter named personService (PersonResource(String personService)) while the field is declared as private final PersonService personService;. This replaces the conceptual dependency on PersonService with an unrelated String type in the solution, breaking the clear mapping from the problem description to the implementation and causing confusion about which service object fulfills the web-layer dependency.
issues.suggested_fix: In the solution repository, change the PersonResource constructor to accept a PersonService parameter and assign it to the field (e.g., public PersonResource(PersonService personService) { this.personService = personService; }). This restores a consistent conceptual mapping (PersonResource depends on PersonService) across problem, template, and solution.
